tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Tonight, prepare for a kaiju-sized spectacle that redefines a classic. Godzilla Minus Zero isn't just monster-mashing; it's a visceral, emotionally charged ride through a nation's struggle against an unstoppable force.

releases.title: Resident Evil
releases.take: Turns out, delivering packages can be more apocalyptic than your worst Amazon Prime nightmare.

releases.title: Model Citizen
releases.take: This ex-cop's amnesia cure involves more paranoia and primal urges than any self-help guru could recommend.

releases.title: Heart of the Beast
releases.take: Man's best friend meets nature's worst in an Alaskan survival tale that'll make you grateful for central heating.

critic.title: The Odyssey
critic.blurb: For the discerning viewer, Primetime offers a chilling dissection of media ambition and the slippery slope of performative justice. It's a nuanced, uncomfortable watch that will spark conversations long after the credits roll.
